messages:
Lina Gomez: hi team, quick onboarding question  I"m running a small CI job that does 1) batch embeddings for 200 docs then 2) a few chat generations. After ~3 minutes the hosted key starts returning 429s. Any obvious mistakes?
DevEx Bot: Welcome Lina! Two quick suspects: (a) you're hitting an embedding unit quota separate from gen token quota, (b) concurrency/streaming limits if your CI fires many workers at once. Check org usage: https://console.redwood.ai/usage. If you include request-ids in a /help ticket we can trace.
Lina Gomez: thanks  the job runs 8 parallel workers that each call embeddings with batch_size=32, then hit the chat endpoint. Is it better to serialize the steps?
Elliot K.: parallel embeddings are fine but they count against embedding unit rate and concurrency. For CI I usually: 1) reduce parallelism to 2-3 workers, 2) increase batch_size to 128 (fewer API calls), and 3) add a small exponential backoff on 429s.
quota-bot: automated: small dev bumps available for 24-48h. Please file form: https://redwood.internal/forms/quota-request and include project, expected rps/tokens, whether streaming, and if embedding-heavy. Tag: @ops-team.
Lina Gomez: good to know. If I switch the heavy part to sandbox, do I need a separate key?
DevEx Bot: yes, sandbox keys are separate. Sandbox is intended for bulk offline/experiment runs and won't touch org hosted quotas. Use sandbox for large vectorization jobs.
Elliot K.: also watch streaming. Even if you don't stream, long-lived connections (e.g., web sockets) can hold concurrency slots. CI should prefer short-lived sync calls.
Lina Gomez: who should I cc on the quota form for a quick dev bump?
Elliot K.: cc @ops-team and @devex on the form, and paste recent logs + request-ids. That speeds things up.
Lina Gomez: perfect. I'll throttle parallelism for now and switch the bulk vectorization to sandbox. Will file the form if I still need a bump. Thanks! :pray:
DevEx Bot: checklist: 1) batch embeddings to reduce calls, 2) lower parallel workers in CI, 3) sandbox for heavy jobs, 4) file quota form + cc ops-team/devex with logs/request-ids if needed. :white_check_mark:
